review_notes.detail: Native paired box borders and roofs support seven banks at columns 50,73,95,119,142,165,188. Human separately approved the nonstandard third-bank column 95 for RT521; proof: low_52_62/RT521 paired native candidate.png.
All rows and both columns of the footer connector table were compared with enlarged native TIFF, along with title, revisions, P.N. 2585940 and BLK BZ.

Original right-edge native TIFF was audited cell by cell. Readable terminal glyphs are retained; unresolvable second and third terminal cells, last header glyph, all five right vertical page-ID cells, and last two bottom 000 cells are �. Third terminal slot c244 is wholly white in the surviving scan, but intentional blank versus eroded 4 cannot be resolved. Candidate complete terminal IDs are the output_rows values; clear left vertical RT521 and title establish the page. Original scan neighbors: RT501 before, RT541 after. review_notes.detail: AS5E has a seven-row body; BS5M has an eight-row body. Native crops show AJ/BJ feeding upper inputs and AP/BP lower inputs on separate stems.
Native bank-one crops print AQ B13, AR G05, BQ B05, BR B09. Crossings remain independent where no diamond is printed; AQ B13 continues to the +PADDL 52 output and BR B09 to +SADDL 05.

The original RT521 places AR G05 on c86 down to row38 then c199 up to +SADDL 04 row36; BQ B05 rises at c61 to +PADDL 53 row50; BR B09 rises at c91 to +SADDL 05 row47. Each crosses unrelated upper/storage wires without a diamond. Paired native source proof: root/accepted_521_541_independent_mid/RT521 AR* and BQ*; BR and 3-bank rail proof: low_52_62/RT521/BQ-BR-bank3-full-native.png and bank3-band0.png.
AK/BK B04 joins c88; AL/BL J05 c87; AM/BM G04 c89; AN/BN D12 c90. The separate BR B09 rail is c91. These align with the original box border c95 and do not join at unmarked crossings.

The native overview and enlarged bank crops were compared against the JuliaMono preview. Four paired 3-bank rails, six 4-bank control rails, register feedback, reset paths and right outputs follow visible source diamonds; unmarked crossings remain separate.
